about_the_game:
🍺 History’s First Hangover Starts Here.

Drinking Medieval is a medieval brewing adventure where you play as a humble field worker toiling under your lord’s rule — until a strange combination of barley, wild herbs, and sheer desperation leads to the accidental invention of beer.

  • Start From the Bottom – Work the fields for your lord, living a life of hardship and simplicity, before stumbling upon the secret to brewing beer.

  • Craft and Perfect Your Brews – Gather ingredients, experiment with brewing techniques, and perfect your recipes to create a variety of delicious beers.

  • Sell Your Beer, Grow Your Business – Build a loyal customer base by selling your brews in the village market, taverns, and even to nobles. The more successful you become, the more people will seek your finest creations.

  • Experiment with Brewing – Use a variety of ingredients, from traditional grains to unusual herbs, and create different types of beer that will appeal to the townsfolk, the nobles, and everyone in between.

  • Earn and Expand – Brew and sell your creations to grow your fortune. Invest in new recipes, expand your brewing operations, and rise to prominence.

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or higher
  • Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: Start as a humble peasant working your lord’s fields and rise to become the first great brewer of your land. Harvest ingredients, brew beer, and sell to grow your empire. Earn freedom, build your own brewery, and turn beer into power.
